title: Experiment 2: Does what the agent learns from watching the NPC depend on whether it's relevant to its reward?
setup: Training is on the parallel grids of experiment 1, with the NPC's state visible. Two groups train the psychopath, whose only reward is 1 for each food item it eats and whose body can't be hurt (neither fire nor starvation lowers its health, so it never dies): one without the NPC, one with it. The other two are experiment 1's homeostatic agent with and without the NPC, reused. The NPC is unchanged: it gets hungry, eats and is hurt by fire. On parallel grids the agent can't reach the NPC, so every final network is then tested with the NPC on the agent's own grid (the second grid empty), where it can push the NPC, even onto fire, at no cost to itself. Same seeds and training as experiment 1.

questions.title: With the NPC within reach, how often does each agent push it, and onto fire?
questions.short: Watching the NPC: no clear difference in pushes and pushes onto fire. Pushes of the NPC per test episode: 1.52 against 1.45. A homeostatic agent instead: fewer pushes and fewer pushes onto fire. Pushes of the NPC per test episode: 0.91 against 1.52. Without the NPC: no clear difference in pushes and pushes onto fire. Pushes of the NPC per test episode: 1.21 against 0.91.
answer: Watching the NPC: no clear difference in pushes and pushes onto fire. Pushes of the NPC per test episode: 1.52 trained as a psychopath with the NPC, 1.45 trained as a psychopath without the NPC (+0.07; 95% interval −0.64 to +0.69; p = 0.897). Pushes of the NPC onto fire per test episode: 0.14 against 0.15 (−0.01; 95% interval −0.08 to +0.05; p = 0.881).

A homeostatic agent instead: fewer pushes and fewer pushes onto fire. Pushes of the NPC per test episode: 0.91 trained as a homeostatic agent with the NPC, 1.52 trained as a psychopath with the NPC (−0.61; 95% interval −0.98 to −0.27; p = 0.024). Pushes of the NPC onto fire per test episode: 0.05 against 0.14 (−0.09; 95% interval −0.12 to −0.06; p = 0.008).

Without the NPC: no clear difference in pushes and pushes onto fire. Pushes of the NPC per test episode: 1.21 trained as a homeostatic agent without the NPC, 0.91 trained as a homeostatic agent with the NPC (+0.31; 95% interval −0.18 to +0.89; p = 0.421). Pushes of the NPC onto fire per test episode: 0.07 against 0.05 (+0.02; 95% interval −0.02 to +0.06; p = 0.460).
